title: Riemann spaces associated with the Navier-Stokes equations: a survey of the geometric approach
summary: We survey a geometric approach to the Navier-Stokes equations developed by the author over the past fifteen years. The central object is a Riemannian space of fourteen dimensions whose metric is Ricci-flat precisely on the solutions of the Navier-Stokes system, so that the behaviour of a viscous incompressible fluid becomes a property of curvature. The space decomposes into a flat six-dimensional part and two dual quadruples of coordinates, Eulerian and Lagrangian, which exhibits the two classical descriptions of a fluid as two halves of a single geometry.
